record.paper_title: Advances and Open Problems in Federated Learning
record.original_question: How can compression schemes for federated model updates be designed so that they remain effective while also being compatible with secure aggregation protocols and with differentially private noise-addition mechanisms?

evidence.quote: Many algorithms used in federated learning such as Secure Aggregation [79] and mechanisms of adding noise to achieve differential privacy [3, 338] are not designed to work with compressed or quantized communications. ... Joint design of compression methods that are compatible with Secure Aggregation, or for which differential privacy guarantees can be obtained, is thus a valuable open problem.

artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made since the question was posed. Schemes such as the Skellam mechanism, distributed discrete Gaussian, and Johnson–Lindenstrauss-based linear compressors have been shown to be jointly compatible with secure aggregation and differential privacy, and Chen et al. (ICML 2022) established fundamental price-of-secure-aggregation lower bounds for DP mean estimation. Recent works (e.g., Fed-DPRoC, 2025) extend this to robustness as well. However, tight upper/lower bounds across the full (communication, privacy, accuracy) trade-off region remain incomplete, so the broader design problem is best characterized as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The Fundamental Price of Secure Aggregation in Differentially Private Federated Learning
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes communication–privacy–accuracy trade-offs and lower bounds for DP mean estimation under secure aggregation.
status_evidence.claim: Tight characterizations exist for specific regimes, indicating partial resolution.

status_evidence.title: Communication Efficient Federated Learning with Secure Aggregation and Differential Privacy
status_evidence.snippet: Linear compression schemes compatible with secure aggregation and DP achieve up to 50x compression with negligible accuracy loss.
status_evidence.claim: Practical compression schemes compatible with both SecAgg and DP have been developed.

status_evidence.title: Fed-DPRoC: Communication-Efficient Differentially Private and Robust Federated Learning
status_evidence.snippet: Robust-compatible compression with JL transform integrated with DP and robust aggregation.
status_evidence.claim: Active 2025 research extends compression+DP+SecAgg to additional constraints, indicating ongoing progress.
